summary: North kerb of a busy four-lane road beside parkland, flats across the road.
reasons: Parkland and trees on own side
No clear parked cars along kerb

best_section.where: Sir Fred Schonell Drive north kerb, beside the park near the ring

drivers.seclusion: Park and trees behind; apartments about 20 m away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide kerbside lane with 2P sign suggests parking is allowed; no cars seen parked on this side.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial with four lanes; noisy.
drivers.convention: 2P weekdays and no stopping 4-6:30pm; no visible overnight parking convention.

flags: Steep: about 4% mean grade, up to 7%
sun_shade: Tree canopy over the kerb, mostly from the north and west; sun from the south.
cannot_judge: Whether the kerb lane is really used for parking
